summary: Phase 4 is accepted. The targeted Sales/API/domain/app gate exits 0 with 30/30 tests passing after acceptance tightened the media-rejection tests to prove MIME/size/duration failures independently of consent/retention failures. The scoped aggregate test and lint closeout gates exit 0. The scoped check-types gate exits 1 only for the verified pre-existing sales-advantage lib/trpc.ts TS2742 errors introduced by scaffold commit 025f8fc9 and unchanged in the Phase 4 diff. Sales roleplay ownership/tenant checks, audio validation before provider/storage, consent/retention UX, and audioStorageKey nullability contracts align with spec and test strategy.
